reviews.comment:
Saque el lavado más caro, no incluye que aspiren el baúl, la chapa tiene suciedad y marcas por todos lados.. lejos de estar bien lavado.. pedí si por favor lo repasaba y me dijeron que no, que la maquina lavado y ellos solo serán...
O sea si necesitas lavar el auto rapido saca solo la maquina y listo, no es perfecta pero zafa.. cualquier otro lavado es robo

(Translated by Google)
I got the most expensive wash, and it didn't include vacuuming the trunk. The car's bodywork was dirty and scratched all over... far from being properly washed. I asked if they could please go over it again, and they said no, that the machine wash is all they do.
So, if you need a quick wash, just get the machine wash and you're good to go. It's not perfect, but it'll do. Any other wash is a rip-off.
